meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用论文搜索工具，按关键词、作者或主题在 arXiv、PubMed、IEEE 等多个平台查找学术文献。
howto.when: 当你说“search for papers”、“find research papers”等，或要求搜索学术论文时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索 arXiv 上关于大模型的论文。
say.note: Claude 会调用论文搜索工具查找 arXiv 预印本。

say.text: 查找 PubMed 里关于糖尿病的文献。
say.note: Claude 会在 PubMed 上检索相关生物医学论文。

say.text: 搜索 IEEE 上关于边缘计算的论文。
say.note: Claude 会使用平台特定搜索查找工程领域文献。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use paper search tools to look up academic papers by keywords, authors, or topics across platforms like arXiv, PubMed, and IEEE.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "search for papers", "find research papers", or ask to look up academic literature.

say_en.text: Search arXiv for papers on large language models.
say_en.note: Claude will call the paper search tool to find arXiv preprints.
Claude will search PubMed for biomedical papers.

say_en.text: Search IEEE for edge computing papers.
say_en.note: Claude will use platform-specific search for engineering literature.
